title: Agents
description: Configurable agent registry. Agents are swappable by id without touching the engine. Templates interpolate PATHS/IDS only (context-hygiene invariant).

prompt_template.description: May reference {instruction} {inputs} {outputs} {repos} — paths only, never file contents.

model.description: Claude model id passed as --model (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Omit to use the CLI default.

effort.description: Effort level mapped to --max-turns (low=15, medium=30, high=60).

max_turns.description: Explicit --max-turns for this agent; overrides the effort-derived value when set.

working_dir.description: Directory the agent process runs in, resolved against and path-guarded to the workspace root. Omit to use the workspace root.

disallowed_tools.description: Opt-in tools to disable for this agent (claude_cli), passed as --disallowedTools. Default [] = allow all (web/TodoWrite/subagents stay on). E.g. ["BashOutput","KillShell","KillBash"] to silence the headless -p background-shell trap.
